name: wts-missing-map-name
description: flat.w3x without war3map.wts (make-melee-valid.mjs nowts), Scenario > Map Description's Name typed over (Renamed Map) and OK (branch we-batch-3). The editor's save then writes a war3map.wts of its own: strings 1 to 4 the name, suggested players, description and author, which the w3i names as TRIGSTR_001 to _004; the player and force names (TRIGSTR_001, _002 without a string) become "". Studio's set_map_text writes the name inline and makes no string table. The dialog's OK also sets the loading screen's crestRace 64 to 128, gameDataSet -1 to 0 and the three camera zooms 0 to 1250 (its defaults), and counts a save more. Expected to differ by these paths until Studio follows (bugs.md).
